# Capability index

<!-- Generated by scripts/capabilities.py — do not edit by hand. -->

Every public name in the four pyrox packages (234 of them), each
listed once at its public home and grouped by the module that defines
it, with the first sentence of its docstring; then the public API of
gaussx, kernellib and geonnax, which the packages build on. Search this
page before writing a helper: if what you need is here, compose it; if
it is almost here, extend it where it lives. Regenerate with
`make capabilities` after changing a public API
(`packages/pyrox/tests/test_capabilities.py` checks it is current).

## `pyrox`

### `pyrox._core`

#### Declarative wrappers for NumPyro param and sample sites. (`pyrox._core.descriptors`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `PyroxParam` | class | Lightweight metadata container for a parameter site. |
| `PyroxSample` | class | Lightweight metadata container for a random sample site. |

#### Parameterized base class for GP-style modules. (`pyrox._core.parameterized`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Parameterized` | class | Shared base for modules with priors, constraints, and mode switching. |

#### PyroxModule and pyrox_method — Equinox-to-NumPyro bridge primitives. (`pyrox._core.pyrox_module`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `PyroxModule` | class | Equinox module with NumPyro site registration and per-call caching. |
| `pyrox_method` | function | Wrap a method so its body runs inside the module's per-call context. |

## `pyrox-lgm`

### `pyrox_lgm`

#### Areal (graph) components: Besag (ICAR), BYM2, proper CAR and Leroux (P7). (`pyrox_lgm._components._areal`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `BYM2` | class | BYM2 (Riebler et al., 2016), a mixture of unstructured and ICAR effects. |
| `Besag` | class | Intrinsic CAR (ICAR / Besag): precision $\tau R$, $R = D - W$. |
| `CAR` | class | Proper CAR: precision $\tau(D - \rho W)$, $\rho \in [0, 1)$. |
| `Leroux` | class | Leroux CAR: precision $\tau(\rho R + (1 - \rho) I)$, $\rho \in [0, 1]$. |

#### Base class for latent components (P7). (`pyrox_lgm._components._base`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AbstractComponent` | class | A latent field with hyperpriors and a projector to observations. |

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Kronecker` | class | Separable product $Q = Q_\text{main} \otimes Q_\text{group}$ (R-INLA ``group``). |
| `Replicate` | class | ``n_rep`` independent copies of a component, sharing its hyperparameters. |

#### Generic components from a user-supplied structure (P7). (`pyrox_lgm._components._generic`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Generic` | class | A field with precision $\tau R$ for a user-supplied structure $R$. |

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `SPDE` | class | Matérn field via the SPDE, on a triangle mesh or a regular grid. |

#### Temporal (and unstructured) components: IID, RW1, RW2 and AR1 (P7). (`pyrox_lgm._components._temporal`)

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AR1` | class | Stationary AR(1), $x_t = \rho x_{t-1} + \varepsilon_t$. |

Listed at gaussx 0.6.5, kernellib 0.0.17, geonnax 0.0.5.

## Upstream: `gaussx`

Structured linear algebra and Gaussians: solve / logdet / Cholesky on structured operators, Gaussian densities and KLs, GP conditioning, Kalman filters, quadrature. Use it instead of `jnp.linalg` or `cho_solve` on a covariance.

## Upstream: `kernellib`

Kernels (`AbstractKernel`, stationary and dot-product families), kernel operators and the pure kernel functions in `kernellib.functional`. pyrox-gp's kernels wrap these.

### `kernellib`

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AbstractEstimator` | class | Configure, `fit`, `predict`. |
| `AbstractFeatureMap` | class | A finite-dimensional approximation ``k(x, x') ≈ φ(x)ᵀ φ(x')``. |
| `AbstractGraph` | class | Weighted, undirected graph without self-loops. |
| `AbstractKernel` | class | Anything that produces a Gram matrix. |
| `AbstractPointwiseKernel` | class | A kernel defined by ``k(x, x')``. |
| `AbstractStationaryKernel` | class | ``k(x, x') = variance * shape(\|\|(x - x') / lengthscale\|\|²)``. |
| `ActiveDims` | class | Apply a kernel to a subset of input dimensions. |
| `CKAAccumulator` | class | Running mini-batch CKA (Nguyen, Raghu & Kornblith, 2021). |
| `Constant` | class | Constant kernel, ``k(x, x') = sigma^2``. |
| `Cosine` | class | Cosine kernel, ``sigma^2 cos(2 pi \|\|x - x'\|\| / p)``. |
| `Derivative` | class | $\partial_{x_i} \partial_{x'_j} k(x, x')$ for fixed input dimensions. |
| `DerivativeIndexed` | class | Joint covariance of a GP's values and partial derivatives. |
| `Distance` | class | Distance-induced kernel, ``k(x, x') = σ² (\|x\|^a + \|x'\|^a - \|x - x'\|^a) / 2``. |
| `EigenPro` | class | Kernel regression by EigenPro-preconditioned SGD (Ma & Belkin, 2017). |
| `EigenProPreconditioner` | class | Spectral correction state for EigenPro kernel SGD. |
| `Falkon` | class | Nyström kernel ridge regression solved by Falkon (Rudi et al., 2017). |
| `FalkonInfo` | class | Convergence report of a `falkon_solve` run. |
| `FalkonPreconditioner` | class | The two upper-triangular Cholesky factors of the Falkon preconditioner. |
| `FastFoodFeatures` | class | FastFood random features (Le, Sarlós & Smola, 2013) for any kernel with a spectral sampler. |
| `FastFoodParams` | class | The random structure of a FastFood feature map. |
| `FeatureKernel` | class | Inner product of features, $k(x, x') = \langle \phi(x), \phi(x') \rangle$. |
| `Graph` | class | Sparse weighted graph: a static topology and traced edge weights. |
| `GraphTopology` | class | Static, hashable edge list of an undirected graph without self-loops. |
| `GridGraph` | class | Regular lattice graph that never stores its edges. |
| `ImplicitCrossKernelOperator` | class | Matrix-free rectangular kernel operator ``K(X, Z) \cdot v``. |
| `ImplicitKernelOperator` | class | Matrix-free kernel operator: ``(K + sigma^2 I) v`` via sequential scan. |
| `KNNGraph` | class | A directed k-nearest-neighbour graph, self excluded. |
| `KRR` | class | Kernel ridge regression. |
| `KernelLocalityPreservingProjections` | class | Kernel locality preserving projections. |
| `KernelOperator` | class | Kernel matrix operator with efficient first-order autodiff. |
| `KernelPCA` | class | Kernel principal component analysis. |
| `KernelSchrodingerProjections` | class | Kernel Schrödinger eigenmap projections. |
| `LaplaceEigenfunctionFeatures` | class | Hilbert-space (HSGP) approximation of a stationary kernel on a box. |
| `LaplacianEigenmaps` | class | Laplacian eigenmaps (Belkin & Niyogi, 2003) of the k-NN graph of ``X``. |
| `Linear` | class | Linear kernel, ``k(x, x') = sigma^2 x^T x' + b``. |
| `LocalityPreservingProjections` | class | Locality preserving projections (He & Niyogi, 2003). |
| `Matern` | class | Matern kernel with closed-form ``nu in {0.5, 1.5, 2.5}``. |
| `Modulated` | class | A kernel with an input-dependent amplitude, $k(x, x') = a(x)\, k_0(x, x')\, a(x')$. |
| `NystromFeatures` | class | Nyström features (Williams & Seeger, 2001) for any kernel. |

| `RBF` | class | Radial basis function (squared exponential) kernel. |
| `RandomFourierFeatures` | class | Random Fourier features (Rahimi & Recht, 2007). |
| `RationalQuadratic` | class | Rational quadratic kernel, a scale mixture of RBFs. |
| `Residual` | class | What an approximation misses, $k(x, x') - \tilde k(x, x')$. |

| `White` | class | White-noise kernel, ``sigma^2 delta(x, x')``. |
| `adjacency_matrix` | function | Symmetric weighted adjacency matrix of a k-NN graph. |

## Upstream: `geonnax`

Deterministic Equinox network cores, encoders and basis functions. pyrox-nn wraps a geonnax core and swaps its parameters for sites.

### `geonnax`

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AbstractConditioner` | class | Duck-typed protocol for ``(h, z) -> y`` conditioning layers. |
| `AffineModulation` | class | Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM): ``y = γ(z) ⊙ h + β(z)``. |
| `Attention` | class | Pre-norm multi-head self-attention with cosine (QK-normalised) similarity. |
| `Block` | class | Conv → GroupNorm → SiLU, the residual-block primitive. |
| `CPTensor` | class | Canonical-Polyadic (CP / PARAFAC) factorization. |
| `Cartesian3DEncoder` | class | Lift a single lon/lat coordinate onto the unit sphere $S^2$. |
| `ConcatConditioner` | class | Concatenate ``h`` and ``z`` then apply a single ``Linear``. |
| `ConditionedINR` | class | Wrap an inner network's per-layer activations with conditioners. |
| `ConvNeXtBlock` | class | ConvNeXt-V2 block: depthwise conv → norm → MLP with GRN (Woo et al., 2023). |
| `CyclicEncoder` | class | Encode a single periodic input as concatenated cos/sin features. |
| `DeepVSSGPCore` | class | Deterministic deep RFF spectral core. |
| `Deg2Rad` | class | Element-wise degrees-to-radians conversion. |
| `DenseRank1` | class | Rank-1 ensemble dense layer (deterministic BatchEnsemble core). |
| `DenseTensor` | class | A full, un-factorised tensor. |
| `DomainPadding` | class | Zero-pad spatial axes by a fraction of their size, then crop back. |
| `Downsample` | class | Memory-efficient factor-2 downsample: space-to-depth, then ``1x1`` conv. |
| `FNO` | class | Fourier Neural Operator: lifting → Fourier blocks → projection. |
| `FNOBlock` | class | One Fourier layer: spectral conv + pointwise skip, then an activation. |
| `FiLM` | class | Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM): ``y = γ(z) ⊙ h + β(z)``. |
| `FourierFilter` | class | Single Fourier filter: $g(x) = \sin(\Omega x + \varphi)$. |
| `FourierNet` | class | Multiplicative Fourier Filter Network (Fathony et al., ICLR 2021). |
| `FourierNeuralOperator` | class | Fourier Neural Operator: lifting → Fourier blocks → projection. |
| `GaborFilter` | class | Single Gabor filter: $g(x) = \sin(\Omega x + \varphi) \odot \exp(-\tfrac{\gamma}{2}\\|x - \mu\\|^2)$. |
| `GaborNet` | class | Multiplicative Gabor Filter Network (Fathony et al., ICLR 2021). |
| `GeneratedSiren` | class | Wrapper around a SIREN whose layers consume generated weights. |
| `GlobalResponseNorm` | class | Global Response Normalization (Woo et al., 2023, "ConvNeXt-V2"). |
| `HeteroscedasticHead` | class | Shared state and init for the FA-noise heteroscedastic layers. |
| `HybridSphericalSlepianEncoder` | class | Concatenate low-bandwidth global SHs with local Slepian cap modes. |
| `HyperLinear` | class | Generate a target ``Linear``'s ``(W, b)`` from ``z``, then apply. |
| `HyperSIREN` | function | NIF-style ShapeNet/ParameterNet composite (Pan, Brunton, Kutz — JMLR 2023). |
| `LaplaceRandomFeatureCovariance` | class | Laplace-approximation precision for an SNGP output head. |
| `LayerNormEnsemble` | class | Per-ensemble-member LayerNorm (deterministic core). |
| `LinearAttention` | class | Pre-norm linear attention — ``O(n)`` in the number of spatial positions. |
| `LonLatScale` | class | Affine-rescale a single lon/lat pair into ``[-1, 1]``. |
| `MCSigmoidDenseFA` | class | Heteroscedastic multi-label output layer (FA noise + sigmoid). |
| `MCSoftmaxDenseFA` | class | Heteroscedastic multi-class output layer (FA noise + softmax). |
| `MSWT` | class | Multi-Scale Wavelet Transformer operator (Wang et al., 2026). |

| `NCPContinuousPerturb` | class | Input perturbation for the Noise Contrastive Prior pattern. |

| `OrthogonalRandomFeatures` | class | Orthogonal Random Features (Yu et al., 2016) — variance-reduced RFF. |
| `RandomFeatureGaussianProcess` | class | SNGP output layer (Liu et al., 2020) — deterministic core. |
| `Rank1ProjInit` | class | Per-projection BatchEnsemble inits used by `MultiHeadAttentionBE`. |
| `ResnetBlock` | class | Two `Block`s with squeeze-excitation and a residual skip. |
| `SFNO` | class | Spherical Fourier Neural Operator: lift → spherical blocks → project. |

| `SphericalWaveletConv` | class | Per-scale channel mixing in the spherical-wavelet domain. |

| `Stage` | class | One encoder/decoder stage: a leaf block, then an optional nested U-Net. |
| `StandardizedConv` | class | Convolution with optional on-the-fly weight standardization. |
| `TTTensor` | class | Tensor-Train (Matrix-Product) factorization. |
| `TuckerTensor` | class | Tucker factorization: a small core contracted with per-mode factor matrices. |
| `UNet` | class | Dimension-flexible U-Net with modern blocks, attention, and nested stages. |

| `WNO` | class | Wavelet Neural Operator: lifting → wavelet blocks → projection. |
| `WNOBlock` | class | One wavelet layer: wavelet conv + pointwise skip, then an activation. |
